figurative_meaning_en: To get caught in the middle of a conflict or difficult situation
similar_in_english: Between a rock and a hard place
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুই বন্ধুর ঝগড়ায় সে ফাঁকে পড়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He got caught in the middle of his two friends' quarrel.
The boy was stuck in the middle of the family dispute.
note: This idiom reflects common social dynamics in Bengali culture where individuals often mediate or suffer in disputes.
